name: Smooth Drinker
body:
You are able to imbibe magical liquids without drawing attention.

Prerequisite(s): Sleight of hand 1 rank.

Benefit(s): Whenever you imbibe a potion, extract, elixir, or similar item, you can make a Sleight of hand check opposed by all observer’s Perception check. If they fail to exceed your check, they do not notice you imbibe your chosen liquid. For each additional round you use this ability to imbibe a liquid, they gain a +5 circumstance bonus to their Perception check.

Special: In a location where constantly drinking would be considered normal, such as at a bar or while eating, you gain a +5 circumstance bonus to your Sleight of hand check.
